ETH.note: The NBE draft strategy is named, but no NBE oversight of the switch is stated.
No protection rule or complaints body stated.
Only a general positioning of G2P work; no programme paid digitally stated.
The platform is for government bill payments; no wallet or retail switch in service stated.

facts.fact: EthSwitch presented its Unified Government Payment Platform at the Ethiopia Finance Forum, a single interoperable route through the national switch for government bill payments by app, ATM, USSD, branch and agent.
